detail.longDescription: 📅 CalDAV server series, part 2: Nextcloud ✅ Journals, Notes and Tasks all work out of the box with no server changes. 🔑 Using 2FA? Create an app password under Settings → Security → Devices & sessions. Your normal password won't work. 📝 Good to know: Nextcloud's own Notes app stores Markdown files, not CalDAV, so it doesn't sync with Spectacled Notes. Tasks do: Spectacled Tasks and Nextcloud Tasks share the same data. https:// spectacled.techbee.at/server-c ompatibility/spectacled-and-nextcloud-works-out-of-the-box/ # Nextcloud # SelfHosted # CalDAV # FOSS
